tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Material: the hardware. The face of a raised panel you could press — the shell bar, the footer, menus, buttons. Sun-faded stadium-seat grey-green, not Win95 grey.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: A panel face one step lighter, for a control raised off a panel.

tokens.name: bevel-light
tokens.usage: The lit edge of a 1px bevel: top and left of a raised surface, bottom and right of a sunken one.

tokens.name: bevel-dark
tokens.usage: The shadowed edge of a 1px bevel: bottom and right of a raised surface, top and left of a sunken one.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a panel.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a panel: the matchday and date in the shell bar, footer notes. Darkened from #4c5348, which was 4.22:1 on the panel; this is 4.76:1.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: Material: the screen. A recessed display where data lives. Deep pitch-green, so numbers read as illuminated.

tokens.name: screen-raised
tokens.usage: A surface one step up inside a screen: table headers, a highlighted block.

tokens.name: screen-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on a screen.

tokens.name: screen-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a screen: labels, notes, units.

tokens.name: screen-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and borders inside a screen: table rules, section dividers.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The page behind everything, around the shell.

tokens.name: champion
tokens.usage: Position band: the champion. Bands encode qualification and relegation the way a Spanish classification does, and are named for the competition, not the colour's role.

tokens.name: ucl
tokens.usage: Position band: a Champions League place.

tokens.name: ucl-ink
tokens.usage: The defender blue as text on the screen material (the DF chip). The band blue is 3.75:1 there; this is 4.79:1.

tokens.name: uel
tokens.usage: Position band: a Europa League place.

tokens.name: uecl
tokens.usage: Position band: a Conference League place.

tokens.name: relegation
tokens.usage: Position band: relegation. Also negative money and losses.

tokens.name: relegation-ink
tokens.usage: Red as text on the screen material: a loss, money below zero, a contract running out. The relegation red itself is 3.45:1 there, too dark to read; this is at least 4.57:1 on every dark surface.

tokens.name: series-a
tokens.usage: Comparison series A, the player being read (the ficha's radar and attribute bars). Same colour as champion: the brass the ficha already highlights with.

tokens.name: series-b
tokens.usage: Comparison series B, the player compared against. Same colour as ucl.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: A won match in a form guide. Same colour as uecl, named for what it means here.

tokens.name: draw
tokens.usage: A drawn match in a form guide. Same colour as ucl.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: A lost match in a form guide. Same colour as relegation.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brass: the one interactive accent, picked up from the trophy. Primary buttons and the focus ring.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: A primary button under the pointer: the accent, a step lighter.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: The accent at 12%, behind your own club's row in a table.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Pure white, for the few marks that must outshine screen-ink: your club's row, the unread count, the play button.

tokens.name: relegation-tint
tokens.usage: Relegation lightened to read as text on a screen: refusals and warnings.

tokens.name: relegation-hover
tokens.usage: The relegation-red play button under the pointer.

tokens.name: chip-fw
tokens.usage: The forward position chip's text. Close to relegation-tint but not the same value; merging them is a visual change, so it waits for a decision.

tokens.name: overlay-1
tokens.usage: White at 3% over a screen: the stripe on alternate table rows.

tokens.name: overlay-2
tokens.usage: White at 4% over a screen: the active offer in the market's offer list.

tokens.name: overlay-3
tokens.usage: White at 7% over a screen: a table row under the pointer.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The void at 72%, behind an open dialog.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: 11px. Labels, table headers, chips, hints.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: 13px. Table cells, buttons, notes.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: 15px. Body text, the page default.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: 20px. Screen and panel headings.

tokens.name: text-xl
tokens.usage: 28px. Headline figures in a stat.

tokens.name: track-wide
tokens.usage: Uppercase labels, buttons and table headers. Personality comes from treatment, not a web font.

tokens.name: track-narrow
tokens.usage: Smaller uppercase runs that the wide tracking would spread too far: chips, pager labels, small captions.

tokens.name: space-hair
tokens.usage: The gap between tightly packed chips and small controls. Tight on purpose: the subject is information-dense.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px. Inside a chip, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px. Between controls in a row; the shell's gutter.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px. Vertical padding of a panel or screen block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px. Horizontal padding of a panel or screen block.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px. Between major sections of a screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The only rounded rectangle: a club in the market's club browser. Hardware is square: panels, screens and buttons have no radius.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: A circle: the Explain "i" button.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: A pill: the unread count beside Notícies.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: A menu floating over the page, like the settings menu. Raised surfaces otherwise use bevels, never shadows.
